subtitle: Lesson 13 · Index & Statistics Administration

code:
SELECT s.name AS stats_name,
       sp.last_updated, sp.rows,
       sp.modification_counter
FROM sys.stats AS s
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_db_stats_properties(
  s.object_id, s.stats_id) AS sp
WHERE s.object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.Orders');
caption: modification_counter is exactly what auto-update logic watches.
